sources.title: Video Generation — xAI developer docs
sources.supports: Model IDs grok-imagine-video-1.5 and grok-imagine-video. Modes: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, first/last frame, video edit, video extension. Duration 1-15s (edit capped 8.7s). Resolution 480p/720p/1080p (1080p on 1.5, t2v+i2v only). Aspect ratios 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 2:3, 3:2. generate_audio=false. last_frame parameter pins the exact last frame; combines with image to pin the first and interpolate. Asynchronous generation.

sources.title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Review: Features, Benchmarks, Pricing & How to Access — CometAPI

sources.title: AI Sprite Generator (Pixel Walk Cycles, Idles, VFX) 2026 — Sorceress Games
sources.supports: Failure modes: subtle frame-to-frame drift (head size, lighting angle, detail level); palette drift across re-rolls; background bleed as a 1-pixel anti-aliased halo from the matte cutout; hand-built pose guides as the mechanism that prevents drift across a sheet.

sources.title: Animation lab notes — Cornell CS5152
sources.supports: Foot-slide mechanics: a walk cycle is frame flipping plus image translation; too little slide reads as marching in place, too much reads as moonwalking.

sources.title: How to Remove Flicker from AI-Generated Video (Shimmer, Boiling, and Jitter)
sources.supports: Temporal artefact taxonomy: high-frequency detail boiling; brightness/colour pulse drifting frame to frame; edges or whole objects wobbling 'as if the frame is not locked'. Basis for the matte-edge instability risk.
